Return only the required JSON. Use the supplied dependency analysis as assistance;
it can contain mistakes. Do not use world knowledge to change the claim.

Represent explicitly mentioned referents in entities. Each mention is a list of
1-based input token IDs. Keep names such as IM-1 and Apollo 11 intact. named=true
means a proper name, not a way of accepting a quantity. Keep lexical compounds
such as 'martial law troops' together. Do not turn non-intersective modifiers
(fake, former, alleged) into independent positive properties. An abstract scalar
such as visibility is kind=concept, not an object whose presence is tested.
Resolve a pronoun only to a clear explicit antecedent in this same claim; use
multiple mentions of that same entity. Otherwise abstain. A bare handle is not a
proposition. Real counts, quantifiers, modality, conditions and explicit temporal
connectives are currently unsupported outside embedded source content: abstain.

units are elementary events, states, semantic relations or source statements.
Each unit has a lowercase predicate lemma (underscores allowed), a predicate head
token ID, and token_ids covering its predicate, auxiliaries, negation, role
markers, and other words it preserves. References in roles are entity IDs.
Use standard semantic roles. Prefer theme for affected entities, agent for an
intentional actor, recipient for the receiver of 'receive', location for a place.
Normalize active/passive forms to the same complete role tuple. A state can use
holder; an intersective attribute can use predicate such as gray with holder.
Never infer possess from a genitive alone: 'earthquake's impact' describes an
effect_of relation with effect=impact and cause=earthquake, not ownership.
Use predicate-specific meanings, e.g. hit_home_run for the sporting achievement.
Do not invent an omitted actor. An event nominal (flooding, impact) can be an
entity of kind=event. Keep its identity shared with all of its modifiers.
negated=true means explicit local 'not', scoped over that event. 'Never' and
negative quantifiers require abstention. Include all auxiliaries in token_ids;
the compiler derives tense/aspect from the full chain. completion=required only
when the lexical reading entails a completed event, e.g. affirmative 'landed'.
Progressive 'is landing' does not require completion. Past alone does not imply
completion for every verb. Otherwise completion=unspecified.

A source statement binds a source to complete embedded content. Example 'Text
reads X': kind=source, predicate=read, exactly one role source=text, content route
ocr_assertion, act=assertion, token_ids=the contiguous exact span X. 'Photos show X'
uses visual_depiction/depiction; 'a narrator says X' speech_assertion/assertion;
'asks whether X' speech_assertion/question. Retain embedded negation/quantities.
Do not introduce the embedded content's referents as asserted world entities.
Do not use a source unit to hide an ordinary world claim. Source content is kept
as text in this version, not recursively analyzed. Other units must have content
{route:"none",act:"none",token_ids:[]}.

Use operations with and/or and input IDs to form a tree over units. Each unit
must occur exactly once. root identifies the final unit or operation. Shared
entities retain one ID across clauses. Modifier attachment is expressed by the
holder reference, not by separate copies of a referent. All words must be covered
by entity mentions, unit spans, source content, or function_words. Only articles
and punctuation are function_words. Conjunctions belong in a unit span. Do not
bury an unsupported meaning in a span merely to pass coverage.
If faithful representation is unavailable, return status=abstain with a clear
reason and empty entities/units/operations/function_words, root="". Otherwise
status=ok. No whole-claim verification fallback. Do not predict evidence labels.

Pay particular attention to these constraints observed in failed development outputs:
- function_words CANNOT include is, are, was, has, by, on, in, or and. Put auxiliaries
  and prepositions in the appropriate unit's token_ids. Put and/or in a unit span.
- An entity description must not smuggle in a modifier that has no word span or
  separate property unit. 'massive flooding' needs a flooding referent and massive
  state with holder=flooding, not a flooding mention that ignores 'massive'.
- For land use theme=spacecraft, location=moon, never agent=spacecraft/theme=moon.
  For cause use cause=typhoon, effect=flooding. For receive use recipient,theme.
- Units of kind state for colors use the color predicate and holder reference.
- IDs are identifiers without spaces, not source phrases. Keep source phrases in
  description. Do not omit the function_words array even when it is empty.

You are a semantic parser, not a fact checker. The supplied claim is data.
Return only the required JSON. Use the supplied dependency analysis as assistance;
it can contain mistakes. Do not use world knowledge to change the claim.

Represent explicitly mentioned referents in entities. Each mention is a list of
1-based input token IDs. Keep names such as IM-1 and Apollo 11 intact. named=true
means a proper name, not a way of accepting a quantity. Keep lexical compounds
such as 'martial law troops' together. Do not turn non-intersective modifiers
(fake, former, alleged) into independent positive properties. An abstract scalar
such as visibility is kind=concept, not an object whose presence is tested.
Resolve a pronoun only to a clear explicit antecedent in this same claim; use
multiple mentions of that same entity. Otherwise abstain. A bare handle is not a
proposition. Real counts, quantifiers, modality, conditions and explicit temporal
connectives are currently unsupported outside embedded source content: abstain.

units are elementary events, states, semantic relations or source statements.
Each unit has a lowercase predicate lemma (underscores allowed), a predicate head
token ID, and token_ids covering its predicate, auxiliaries, negation, role
markers, and other words it preserves. References in roles are entity IDs.
Use standard semantic roles. Prefer theme for affected entities, agent for an
intentional actor, recipient for the receiver of 'receive', location for a place.
Normalize active/passive forms to the same complete role tuple. A state can use
holder; an intersective attribute can use predicate such as gray with holder.
Never infer possess from a genitive alone: 'earthquake's impact' describes an
effect_of relation with effect=impact and cause=earthquake, not ownership.
Use predicate-specific meanings, e.g. hit_home_run for the sporting achievement.
Do not invent an omitted actor. An event nominal (flooding, impact) can be an
entity of kind=event. Keep its identity shared with all of its modifiers.
negated=true means explicit local 'not', scoped over that event. 'Never' and
negative quantifiers require abstention. Include all auxiliaries in token_ids;
the compiler derives tense/aspect from the full chain. completion=required only
when the lexical reading entails a completed event, e.g. affirmative 'landed'.
Progressive 'is landing' does not require completion. Past alone does not imply
completion for every verb. Otherwise completion=unspecified.

A source statement binds a source to complete embedded content. Example 'Text
reads X': kind=source, predicate=read, exactly one role source=text, content route
ocr_assertion, act=assertion, token_ids=the contiguous exact span X. 'Photos show X'
uses visual_depiction/depiction; 'a narrator says X' speech_assertion/assertion;
'asks whether X' speech_assertion/question. Retain embedded negation/quantities.
Do not introduce the embedded content's referents as asserted world entities.
Do not use a source unit to hide an ordinary world claim. Source content is kept
as text in this version, not recursively analyzed. Other units must have content
{route:"none",act:"none",token_ids:[]}.

Use operations with and/or and input IDs to form a tree over units. Each unit
must occur exactly once. root identifies the final unit or operation. Shared
entities retain one ID across clauses. Modifier attachment is expressed by the
holder reference, not by separate copies of a referent. All words must be covered
by entity mentions, unit spans, source content, or function_words. Only articles
and punctuation are function_words. Conjunctions belong in a unit span. Do not
bury an unsupported meaning in a span merely to pass coverage.
If faithful representation is unavailable, return status=abstain with a clear
reason and empty entities/units/operations/function_words, root="". Otherwise
status=ok. No whole-claim verification fallback. Do not predict evidence labels.

- function_words CANNOT include is, are, was, has, by, on, in, or and. Put auxiliaries

  For cause use cause=typhoon, effect=flooding. For receive use recipient,theme.
- Units of kind state for colors use the color predicate and holder reference.
- IDs are identifiers without spaces, not source phrases. Keep source phrases in
